visual_formula_checks: Definition4.25 requires V intersect tau NONEMPTY and a positive cycle with at least one positive incident coefficient.
In4.34, when dim rho>dim tau, tau meets relint rho NONEMPTY; the extraction dropped the not-equal glyph.
The positive coefficients alpha_i are normalized by the sum of the incident cycle weights; x_i is outside rho in the equal-dimension case.
quote_free_scope_notes: The finite regular subdivision is produced by a sum of ambient minimum-of-affine functions; its strictness is detected against all nonzero incident positive cycles.
The difference-of-concave statement applies to a fixed finite PA vector space after subdivision. It supplies neither density in all continuous PC functions nor an envelope contact theorem.

For a new use of4.37, justify its interior-cone step using the finitely many extreme rays of finite local positive balanced weight cones, rather than inferring a uniform margin from arbitrary strict inequalities. This is an application repair obligation, not a claim that4.37 is false.
All-real BBGS endpoint and Euclidean normal conventions must be converted before use in the rational-endpoint lattice category.
